audit_notes: No direct contradiction proved in the five local source_details sets. Important refinement: governor range is an assumed construction era within a tenure; house 2524 is repair, not a replacement for 2460 construction claim.
ONEP general town chronology has problematic dates outside the table. Authority alone is not blanket proof; do not import all historical chronology from that report.

Name variants: บ้านขุนอินทร์ / ตึกขุนอินทร์; report person name ขุนอินทรคีรี; school เต้าหมิง; wall กำแพงค่าย / กำแพงเมือง (not proof that it enclosed the whole town); bridge source table title สะพานเหล็ก.
Do not promise current visiting hours, entry fee, interior access, road safety, or still-operating businesses from dated heritage sources.
Rendered evidence pages are audit artifacts, not licensed website photography. No full publications copied into the site.
